body:
This sentence sounds strange: 
"SAML is neither the best or remain the authentication solution - it might be swapped out with JWT or similar as needs arise. "

Suggested edit:
"However, SAML will not always remain as the best or most suitable authentication solution - it might need to be swapped out for other solutions as requirements change."
title: V1 - Control Objective - "SAML is neither the best or remain the authentication solution"
